notes.title: Shortcuts Unlock Replays Now
notes.content:
We set out to achieve two things:
- Players should be able to improve their runs by watching replays of other players.
- Players shouldn't get spoiled and find the main shortcuts themselves.

We achieve both with our new shortcut system. Once you have found the main shortcut in a level, a light bulb will appear next to your score 💡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048686/b3011be6a9b80fde9d78e083e0093cdbd7664afc.png[/img]

You'll then be able to view all replays on the leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048686/e286b4c640c3a5fd2c60eb77b8c86374b58a2679.png[/img]

Finding the main shortcut (💡) is pretty manageable and gives you access to more hardcore shortcuts from the leaderboard. Shortcuts are still optional. Although without one, you'll have to play very well to gain the best medal 💎

We've also added rebindable controls, simplified Chinese and we're currently working on a new level 🔥
